individual-data-points.explanation: Panel A is a grid of fluorescence micrographs (GFP, DsRed, MitoTracker, merge), not a plot of averaged data.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Panel A is a micrograph panel, not a plot, so error bars are not relevant.

individual-data-points.explanation: The JC-1 relative-intensity and anti-HMGB1 intensity bar charts show group means with error bars (n=20) but no individual data points are overlaid.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Error bars appear on both bar charts, but neither the figure image annotations (n=20, p-value thresholds) nor the caption state whether they represent SD, SEM, or another measure of variability.

individual-data-points.explanation: Panel C is a western blot image, not a plot of averaged data.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Panel C is a blot, not a plot, so error bars are not relevant.

individual-data-points.explanation: The SDH and COX signal-intensity bar charts show group means with error bars and sample sizes noted inside the bars, but no individual data points are plotted.

error-bars-defined.explanation: Error bars are shown on the SDH/COX quantification bar charts; the accompanying text only reports the statistical test used (Tukey's test following one-way ANOVA) but does not state what the error bars themselves represent.

individual-data-points.explanation: The FACS TMRM histograms display full population distributions (counts vs. intensity) rather than summarized means, so individual data points are not required, analogous to a line/histogram plot.

error-bars-defined.explanation: The FACS histogram plots in panel E show raw distribution curves without error bars, so no definition is required.
